approx_cache_root.description: Top-level directory where Approx stores cached Debian packages.

compress_downloads.description: If true, Approx will request and store compressed (`.gz`) package files to save disk space.

allowed_networks.description: List of network ranges (CIDR or IP) permitted to use this Approx proxy.

items.description: Allowed network in CIDR or IP format (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24')

mirrors.description: Upstream Debian repositories to cache. Each entry defines the package type, suite (e.g., stable, bullseye), and mirror URL.

type.description: Package type: 'deb' for binary, 'deb-src' for source packages.

url.description: Base URL of the mirror (must end with '/debian' or '/debian/' for most mirrors).

upstream_proxy.description: HTTP(S) proxy URL for outgoing connections (e.g., 'http://proxy.example.com:3128'). Leave empty to connect directly.

local_hostname.description: Hostname to use in the `Host` HTTP header (e.g., 'apt.internal.local'). Useful behind reverse proxies.

disabled_architectures.description: List of architectures to exclude from caching (to save disk space). Examples: 'arm64', 'ppc64el', 's390x'.

stale_age.description: If > 0, Approx will refresh cached files older than this many seconds. Set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.

cache_size_limit_mb.description: Maximum cache size in megabytes. 0 = unlimited. Approx will stop caching if limit is exceeded.

listen_addresses.description: IP addresses Approx should listen on (one per Listen directive). Use '127.0.0.1' to restrict to localhost.

listen_port.description: Port number for the Approx HTTP server.
